originalTitle: Watch: What we know about suspected crime boss Daniel Kinahan
summary: Suspected crime boss Daniel Kinahan, one of the world's most wanted men, has spent his first night in custody in Ireland after being extradited from Dubai.
content:
Suspected cartel leader Daniel Kinahan has appeared in front of a special non-jury court in Dublin after an extradition treaty between Ireland and the UAE brought his 10 years of exile in Dubai to an abrupt end.

Kinahan, aged 49, has been charged with directing the activities of a criminal organisation between 18 October 2015 and 6 April 2017. He has previously denied all charges against him.

But what do we know about Daniel Kinahan, one of the most wanted men in the world, and his alleged leadership of the billion-dollar Kinahan cartel?

More on this story: Suspected crime boss Kinahan spends first night in custody in Ireland
chineseTitle: 观看：我们对犯罪头目嫌疑人丹尼尔·基纳汉的了解
chineseSummary: 犯罪头目嫌疑人丹尼尔·基纳汉 (Daniel Kinahan) 是全球头号通缉犯之一，从迪拜引渡回国后，他在爱尔兰度过了被拘留的第一个晚上。
chineseContent:
涉嫌卡特尔头目丹尼尔·基纳汉 (Daniel Kinahan) 出现在都柏林一个特别的无陪审团法庭前，爱尔兰与阿联酋之间的引渡条约结束了他在迪拜 10 年的流亡生涯。

基纳汉现年 49 岁，被指控在 2015 年 10 月 18 日至 2017 年 4 月 6 日期间指挥犯罪组织的活动。他此前否认对他的所有指控。

但是，我们对世界头号通缉犯之一丹尼尔·基纳汉（Daniel Kinahan）以及他所谓的价值数十亿美元的基纳汉贩毒集团的领导者了解多少呢？
